name: env-diff
title: Env Diff
description: Compares two environments key by key, lists missing and empty keys first, flags production values pointing at localhost, a test key or the staging host, and secrets reused across both, masking every secret behind a short fingerprint.

meta.summary: Compares two environments key by key and flags missing keys, localhost in production and reused secrets, masking secrets so the diff is safe to share.
meta.server: Validate required config at deploy time on the server, and keep secrets in a secrets manager rather than in shared diffs.
catches: Keys missing or empty in one environment
Production values that point at localhost, a test key or a staging host
A copy of the missing keys, ready to fill
limits: Fingerprints are 4-hex-digit FNV hashes: fine for spotting reuse, but they can help confirm guesses of short, weak secrets, so don't share diffs of weak secrets
Which keys are secret is decided by isSecret or name patterns
a11y: The comparison is a labelled list; masked dots are aria-hidden and secrets have a labelled icon
